clips.title: The story
paras: Missing In Action is an Alliance escort mission in the Redridge Mountains to rescue Corporal Keeshan from Blackrock orc captivity. After his regiment was wiped out in the hills, Keeshan was knocked unconscious and dragged into a cave fortress. Guiding the wounded soldier safely back to Lakeshire helps the local garrison confirm the grim fate of their missing men.

The Redridge Mountains have grown increasingly perilous as Blackrock orcs descend from the northern peaks. Patrols sent out by the town guard frequently run into ambushes, and Corporal Keeshan's unit suffered the worst of it. Outnumbered and overwhelmed, most of the soldiers in his regiment were cut down on the spot. Keeshan survived only because a crushing blow knocked him cold before he could be executed, allowing the orcs to drag him back to their cave as a prisoner.

Battered, concussed, and held deep within enemy territory, Keeshan could not make the trek back down the mountain alone. Escorting him down to the safety of Lakeshire takes him past swarming orc warbands that occupy the ridgelines. Reaching Lakeshire alive brings sorely needed relief to Marshal Marris, who has been trying to piece together what happened to the missing regiment while bracing Lakeshire for further attacks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At last, friends of the Alliance!

The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly.
I'll need help getting back to town... Please... You're my last hope...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served the Kingdom well, adventurer. Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
